text: To obtain Scarborough Community Council approval for the amendment of the Fire Route By-law to amend the designation of the property municipally known as 1-70 Eglinton Square as a fire route within the meaning of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 880, as amended. The fire route in question was listed with the incorrect municipal address of 1-70 Eglinton Avenue East with the transfer of the old Scarborough Fire Route By-Law addresses to the new Chapter 880. The address listed in Schedule A, Fire Route Designations to Chapter 880 requires correcting. Fire Services uses designated fire routes as a key mechanism in regulating fire prevention, including the prevention of spreading of fires and the delivery of fire protection services.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated part or those parts of the private road or roads shown on the site plan filed with the Fire Chief in respect of the municipal address set out below, as fire route pursuant to Municipal Code Chapter 880 - Fire Route - 1-70 Eglinton Square. 2. Authorized the Fire Chief and City Solicitor to take the appropriate action to make a designated Fire Route.
